result.final_text:
## What this letter says

You have an appointment for an echocardiogram. This is an ultrasound scan of your heart. The hospital has booked you for this test.

The appointment is on Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40. It will be at the Cardiac Investigations Unit, Level 2.

You do not need to fast before this test. You do not need to stop any of your medicines.

## What you need to do

1. Arrive 15 minutes before your appointment time.
2. Bring a list of all the medicines you take.
3. If you cannot attend, call 01632 960 123 at least 48 hours before your appointment.

## Dates and medicines

**Your appointment:**
- Tuesday 17 November 2026 at 10:40
- Echocardiogram (heart ultrasound scan)
- Cardiac Investigations Unit, Level 2

You do not need to fast or stop any of your medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor

- What does the echocardiogram show?
- How long will the appointment take?
- When will I get the results?

## When to get urgent help

The letter does not list specific warning signs.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
